title: Constructive Algebraic, Poincaré, and Cartier-Residue Certificates for Permanent and Hamiltonian Cycle Circuit Lower Bounds
abstract: We present PERM-HC-LB-CERT-1.0, an independently reproducible, zero-floating-point verification framework and constructive Lean 4.35.0 kernel auditing the core finite-dimensional algebraic, sparse-gadget, balanced-cut, nonlinear Poincaré, Hadamard-cone, exterior-minor, and Cartier/eigenvalue counting-contradiction mechanisms underlying OpenAI's November 24, 2026 unrefereed preprint 'Circuit lower bounds for Hamiltonian cycle and the permanent' (Theorems 1.1, 3.1, 4.2, and 12.2). Without claiming to formalize infinite-dimensional Hadamard-cone ultralimits, observable-entropy reservoir coding, or universal RAM compression end-to-end, we construct a four-mode exact verifier over Z, Q, and F_p paired with 18 constructive Lean 4 theorems (0 sorry, 0 custom axioms, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings). Across 16 canonical certificates (C01-C16), we certify Lemma 3.4's 3x3 permanent coupling gadget over Q and F_7 and Corollary 3.5 degree-<=3 digraph evaluations of Per_N, Det_N, and HC_N (including characteristic-2 collapse), Section 1.3 balanced-cut crossing ranks (5,5,8 > q^2=4) and Lemma 4.1/Theorem 4.2 exact Poincaré ratios and barycentric smoothing Eq. (4.1) on C_4, C_6, and Q_3, Section 3.2 Hadamard-cone two-supplier transport savings and Section 8-9 alternating exterior minor tensors satisfying the classical Plücker relations, and Section 18 Cartier operator residue extraction over F_5 and F_2 with Section 19 Eq. (19.1)-(19.2) finite-field eigenvalue counting contradictions. All 16 certificates, 60 unit/forgery tests, and 37 SHA-256 hashes verify deterministically.
